## What's new in Draftava 1.3.24
- Fixed conversion of existing projects when saving the converted copy directly in iCloud Drive or another selected parent folder. - Converted projects now receive readable folder names, such as `TCP Newsletter V2`. - Added numbered suffixes when a converted project folder already exists. - Preserved the original project name inside Draftava. - Improved folder selection instructions during conversion. - Fixed opening and restoring converted projects with readable folder names.
Conversion creates a separate V2 project and preserves the original V1 project.
